_comment: Owner switch for lake sponsor slots (owner apply #3, 2026-10-20). One slot per listed lake. While 'sponsor' is null the slot shows the house ad that links to /advertise/. To sell it, set sponsor to {"name": "...", "line": "one sentence, max 90 characters", "url": "https://..."}; the link gets rel="sponsored noopener" and the label stays "Advertisement". Traffic numbers are the GA4 figures quoted on /advertise/; update them with their period, never round them up.
